stopConditions: A legitimate existing save Lust value is rewritten to 5.
A fresh/new life starts at Lust 1 or any value other than 5.
Any D46 wage base is not 35/37 as specified.
Any ordinary shift can pay more than 120.
Any non-ordinary wage is captured by the D46 ordinary helper.
Any D47 package identity/component differs from v53.
A D47 package auto-applies merely because it was earned.
A D47 package applies more than once after reload/re-entry.
A D47 package consumes Keystone/Specialist capacity.
Hard Work becomes eligible before 50 completed shifts.
Live lumber-stay or vitality acquisition reappears.
Duplicate historical evidence yields more than +1 legacy Energy.
Historical evidence fabricates hardWork:lumber or Palace qualification.
Existing historical lumber RunResult/transaction proof is rewritten or replayed.
Canonical ordinary ending count differs from 40 after retirement.
Any unlisted current-main system is removed by whole-file historical replacement.
Secret Debt/D51, Activity, Night, Palace, Strong Meta or current migration tests regress.
Retired live localization/presentation identifiers remain player-facing.
Historical compatibility localization/UI becomes unavailable for old saves.
thirdValueRules: For every manifest-owned scalar/keyed field: old expected value -> desired value is allowed; desired already present is idempotent; any third value requires STOP/review.
For exact-ID deletion: present historical live ID -> delete; already absent -> idempotent; renamed/replaced current ID -> STOP/review rather than wildcard deletion.
For shared files: authority snapshot and live base are never treated as binary choices; preserve unowned live-base semantics and apply only listed semantic operations.

For test expectations: if a current accepted semantic authority intentionally changes a value after these authorities, STOP and obtain Leader disposition rather than forcing the golden historical value.
